# Stockpile

**Tags:** `container`

The container a settlement's members fill and draw from together. Its capacity in stacks grows with the settlement tier, and each role has a daily withdraw limit. Phase 204 turns it into a clan chest with the same contents (Clan.migration); research no longer draws from it (Phase 203).

> **Goal:** Give a settlement a shared store so cooperation is worth more than trading (Phase 139)

## Fields

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| ---- | ---- | -------- | ----------- |
| `id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `capacityStacks` | integer | yes | Stacks the stockpile holds at the current tier (Settlement rules.stockpile) |
| `usedStacks` | integer | yes | Stacks currently held |

## Behaviors

### `deposit`

A member with build or take permission adds items to the stockpile

**Rules:**
- Only members of the owning settlement may deposit
- A deposit beyond capacityStacks is refused whole, with no partial transfer
- Item totals are preserved: what is deposited is what is held

**Auth:** `maintainer`

### `withdraw`

A member takes items from the stockpile

**Rules:**
- The role must have take permission
- A withdraw beyond the role's daily withdrawLimit is refused
- Guests never withdraw; the founder is not limited

**Auth:** `maintainer`
